name: David Cicilline
summary:
David Nicola Cicilline ( sih-sih-LEE-nee; born July 15, 1961) is an American lawyer and politician who served as the U.S. representative for Rhode Island's 1st congressional district from 2011 to 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, he was the 36th mayor of Providence from 2003 to 2011, the first openly gay mayor of a U.S. state capital.
Cicilline chaired the House Judiciary Committee's Subcommittee on Antitrust, Commercial and Administrative Law.
